datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

curves.name: BZT52C30 zener characteristic
curves.test_conditions: Ta = 25 degC, pulsed; BZT52C30 trace labeled 30 in Fig. 2; PD = 500 mW envelope shown in the figure

reverse_current.conditions: IR = 0.1 microA maximum at VR = 21.0 V, Ta = 25 degC

breakdown_voltage.conditions: VZ nominal at IZT = 2 mA, Ta = 25 degC; table bounds 28.50 V minimum and 31.50 V maximum

breakdown_current.conditions: IZT = 2 mA for the stated nominal zener voltage, Ta = 25 degC

extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: the nominal breakdown voltage VZ = 30.0 V is paired with the tabulated IZT = 2 mA test current.
The BZT52C30 table row gives VZ = 28.50 V minimum, 30.00 V nominal, and 31.50 V maximum at IZT = 2 mA; maximum ZZT = 80 ohm at IZT; maximum ZZK = 300 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA; admissible IZM = 2 mA.
The BZT52C30 row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 21.0 V and temperature-coefficient limits of 24.4 to 29.4 mV/degC at IZTC, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C30 trace labeled 30 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values from 0.5 mA through 10 mA; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.
The BZT52C30 trace terminates below the 20 mA grid level at the plotted PD = 500 mW envelope, so no 20 mA point was recorded.

Capacitance is shown only as family-level typical curves in p. 3 Fig. 3 at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz, with 0 V, 1 V, and 50% of nominal VZ bias curves; no tabulated BZT52C30 capacitance value is provided, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification or test circuit is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
Absolute maximum PD is 350 mW on p. 1; the p. 3 pulsed characteristic plot separately shows a 500 mW envelope and is preserved as the plot condition rather than substituted for the rating.
